text:
GENERATE BURST GS-BMAULL -- Run C-9 Phase 2 (Matt R-C9-98): RE-PROPORTION the champion's two-handed GREAT MAUL model sheet: a longer, slimmer haft and a smaller head, and change nothing else of its design. task_id "GS-BMAULL".

IMAGE 1 is the maul's three-view model sheet for 3D: ONE war maul in THREE orthographic views side by side, head at the top -- LEFT the broad side, MIDDLE turned 90 degrees (a striking face toward the viewer), RIGHT the other broad side. As drawn it is too SQUAT for a two-handed great maul: the head is 0.42 of the whole length (it should be about 0.26), and the haft is as thick as half the head's height, so in a big man's hands it reads as a sledge-hammer with a fence-post handle.
Use image_gen in EDIT mode on IMAGE 1 and deliver ONE 1536x1024 sheet, the SAME three views in the SAME order side by side, at ONE common scale, the butts on one ground line near the bottom edge, the tops near the top edge, nothing overlapping:
- THE HAFT becomes LONG and SLIM: its thickness about ONE THIRD of the head's height, and from the underside of the head down to the butt about THREE head-lengths. The same dark wood, the same iron langets below the head, the same TWO leather-wrapped grip sections (one at the butt, one at mid-haft) with their iron collars, the same faceted iron butt cap, all redrawn to the slimmer haft.
- THE HEAD keeps its design and its proportions to itself (a heavy rectangular iron block with bevelled ends and a striking face at each end, the bronze bands near each end, the gilded laurel sprigs on each broad side), only drawn SMALLER so the whole maul fits. ONE change on it: the round central medallion now holds a small gilded LAUREL WREATH around a plain round boss, in place of the lily emblem.
Sizes in pixels on the 1024-pixel-tall sheet, approximately: the whole maul 980 tall; the head 255 long and 90 tall; the haft 30 thick; each grip section about 120 long.
Paint in IMAGE 1's own hand and colours. Soft even light, no glow, no cast shadows, no ground, no text, no labels. No hand, no person, no strap.
BACKGROUND: flat pure #00ff00. If the image model returns a darker or gradient background anyway, still deliver the image.

ONE image_gen EDIT call. NO RETRY (the image budget is fixed): if the result has a fault, deliver it anyway and NAME it in concerns -- the head still more than a third of the whole length, the haft thicker than half the head's height, the head design changed beyond the medallion, a view missing, the views disagreeing in length, or a hand, person or text appearing. Copy the output to out/GS-BMAULL.png with its sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "GS-BMAULL"; images = the file with prompt, references (role + path) and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.
